| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 0.001 | 0.0001 to 0.05 | The smallest Hessian response a keypoint needs, for an image from 0 to 1. OpenCV uses 0.001. |
| **Octaves** `octaves` | 4 | 1 to 8 | The number of octaves. OpenCV uses 4. |
| **Layers per octave** `octaveLayers` | 4 | 1 to 8 | The number of layers in each octave. OpenCV uses 4. |
| **Diffusivity** `diffusivity` | Perona-Malik g2 | Perona-Malik g1, Perona-Malik g2, Weickert, Charbonnier | How strongly edges stop the smoothing. OpenCV uses Perona-Malik g2. |
